landing.greetingMsg2: After years of navigating the world as a duo, we’re officially upgrading to a lifelong partnership. We are honored to have you join us as we exchange our 'I do’s' and celebrate the start of our best chapter yet.

landing.attireGuideMsg: Dress Code: <1>Semi-formal, think spring vibes and earthy tones!</1>  Basically, look like a stylish forest! Please choose comfortable shoes that won't betray you on the dance floor and are ready for a marathon of celebration. If your feet are happy, we’re happy.
landing.rsvpMsg: Final boarding call! Please RSVP by February 28th, 2026, to secure your spot for our biggest adventure yet. We’ve got a seat (and a drink) with your name on it, see you on the dance floor!
landing.footerMsg: Thanks for keeping us sane and being our favorite humans. The paperwork and planning are finally done—now we just need you to show up, help us make some memories, and witness our questionable dance moves. Let’s see how much we actually remember the next day!

weddingDetails.title: Transportation
weddingDetails.content:
Transportation to Ciao Tou Sugar Refinery, Kaohsiung City:
1. Take the MRT Red Line to Ciao Tou Sugar Refinery Station, then it's about a 5-minute walk to the venue.
2. If driving, parking is available at the refinery, but spaces are limited. We recommend carpooling or using public transportation.
3. If you need assistance with transportation arrangements, please let us know in advance.

weddingDetails.title: Accommodation
weddingDetails.content:
Accommodation options near Ciao Tou Sugar Refinery, Kaohsiung City:
1. The refinery offers simple lodging facilities that require advance booking.
2. Several hotels are nearby, such as Fullon Hotel Kaohsiung and Ciao Tou Business Hotel, approximately 10-15 minutes by car.
3. We recommend booking early to secure accommodation, especially since demand is high on the wedding day.
